source: How do I make my houseplant stop wilting?
target_a: Check the soil moisture first. Most wilting is from over- or under-watering: water only when the top inch of soil is dry, ensure the pot drains, and keep it out of harsh direct sun. If leaves stay limp after a good watering, check for root rot.
target_b: Just water it more and it should be fine.

source: Explain what a hash function is, simply.
target_a: A hash function takes any input and turns it into a fixed-size string of characters. The same input always gives the same output, but even a tiny change to the input produces a very different result, and you can't easily reverse it to get the original.
target_b: A hash function is a function that hashes things into hashes using hashing.

source: What's a good first exercise for someone new to running?
target_a: Try a run/walk approach: alternate one minute of easy jogging with two minutes of walking, for about 20 minutes, three times a week. It builds endurance while limiting injury risk, and you gradually increase the jogging intervals.
target_b: Run 10 km on day one to build a strong base quickly.

source: How can I reduce my phone's battery drain?
target_a: Lower the screen brightness and shorten the auto-lock time, turn off background app refresh for apps you don't need live, and disable location access for apps that don't require it. Checking which apps use the most battery in settings helps you target the biggest offenders.
target_b: Battery drain happens because of the battery. Buy a new phone.

source: Is it safe to eat food that fell on the floor?
target_a: The "five-second rule" isn't reliable: bacteria can transfer almost instantly, and the risk depends on the surface and the food. Dry food on a clean, dry surface is lower risk; moist food on a dirty surface is best discarded.
target_b: Yes, the five-second rule means it is always safe.

source: How do I start composting at home?
target_a: Use a bin or pile and balance "greens" (fruit/veg scraps, coffee grounds) with "browns" (dry leaves, cardboard). Keep it about as damp as a wrung-out sponge, turn it every week or two for air, and avoid meat and dairy to deter pests.
target_b: Just throw all your trash in a pile outside and wait.
